title: Annotatio I §.III (y): Baptismal definitives — signata of the sign; metonymy or synecdoche
pass_a_gloss: When (y) in some Baptismal definitives: Baptism is the putting on of Christ, Gal. 3:27; also, it is the appeal of a good conscience toward God, 1 Pet. 3 — the Holy Spirit predicates only the Signified things of Baptism of the Sign, whether bare, i.e. the external baptism, or exhibitive, i.e. of the whole baptism consisting of internal and external part — it cannot be denied that a Metonymic or Synechdochic predication is made.
pass_b_english: (y) In some baptismal definitives — Baptism is putting on Christ (Gal. 3:27); it is the appeal of a good conscience toward God (1 Pet. 3) — the Spirit predicates only Baptism’s signified things of the sign.
Whether the sign is bare external baptism or the whole exhibitive rite, the predication is metonymic or synechdochic; that cannot be denied.
source_text: Quando (y) in definitivis Baptismatis nonnullis: Baptisma est indutio Christi Gal. 3. 27. item, est ἐπερώτημα συνειδήσεως ἀγαθῆς εἰς Θεόν 1. Petr. 3. Spiritus S. sola Baptismatis Signata, de Signo, sive nudo, i. e. baptismate externo, sive exhibitivo, i. e. de integro baptismo, ex interna & externa parte constante, praedicat, negari nequit, vel Metonymicam vel Synechdochicam praedicationem fieri.
